pages.name: Petrov Defense: Stafford Gambit
pages.notes: Plan 1 had '...h4' (the h-pawn is on h7); rewrote it around 5...Ne4, ...Bc5, ...Qh4 and the 6.d3 Bc5 7.dxe4? Bxf2+ trap. British spelling in the overview and plan 2.

pages.name: Petrov's Defence, Damiano Variation
pages.notes: The overview described a queen trade and a black pawn left on e5; in fact 5...d6 6.d4 dxe5 7.dxe5 leaves White a clean pawn up. Plans 1 and 3 supported or attacked an e5-pawn that is a knight; plan 2 overstated a decisive attack. Rewrote the overview and plans 1-3.

pages.name: Petrov's Defence: Stafford Gambit
pages.notes: Plan 1 skipped the forced 4...dxc6 and played ...d5 with no d-pawn; plan 3 had White's h3 in Black's plan. Rewrote both (plan 3 now gives the 5.d3 Bc5 6.Bg5? Nxe4! 7.Bxd8 Bxf2+ 8.Ke2 Bg4 mate trap). British spelling in plans 2 and 4.

pages.name: Petrov's Defense
pages.notes: Plan 1 pressed a black e4-pawn that is a knight; plan 3's ...c5 replaced with the standard ...d5, ...Bd6/...Be7, ...Nc6, ...O-O. Plan 1 now includes 5.Nc3 with long castling. British spelling in the overview and plan 2.

pages.name: Petrov's Defense: Classical Attack
pages.notes: Plan 1 used an e4-pawn White no longer has; plan 2's ...c5 replaced with ...d5 and normal development. British spelling in the overview.

pages.name: Petrov's Defense: Classical Attack, Berger Variation
pages.notes: Plan 1 named an e5-pawn in Black's chain (the chain is d5 and f5); plan 2 had White's c4 in Black's plan; plan 3 targeted the f5-pawn with Qc2 behind the d3-bishop, now Qb3 against d5. British spelling in the overview and plan 4.

pages.name: Petrov's Defense: Classical Attack, Chigorin Variation
pages.notes: Plan 3 routed the b1-knight from d2 (d2-f1-g3); now Nbd2 or Nc3 against the e4-knight. Plan 2's ...c5 replaced with the main line ...Bg4 and ...f5. British spelling in the overview and plan 2.

pages.name: Petrov's Defense: Classical Attack, Closed Variation
pages.notes: Plan 1 used an e4-pawn White no longer has; rewrote it. British spelling in the overview, plans 2 and 4.

pages.name: Petrov's Defense: Karklins-Martinovsky Variation
pages.notes: Plan 3 routed the knight via c1-e2 (the c1-bishop is on c1); now Nf4 or Nf2 after f3. British spelling in the overview and plans 2 and 4.

pages.name: Petrov's Defense: Kaufmann Attack
pages.notes: needs-research: plan 2 targets an e4-pawn that is a black knight. Two rewrites were rejected by the reviewer (the counterplay against the d-pawn and d4-square could not be confirmed, and the structure is not symmetrical after ...Nxc3 dxc3), so the old text is kept, with British spelling only, and the reference added to the skips. British spelling in the overview and plan 3.
